name: eBay used AMD Instinct MI250 / MI250X 128GB OAM module (with heatsink)
price_basis: USED, OAM module WITH heatsink - NOT a PCIe card. $5,450 = midpoint of the $4,950-5,970 ask band captured 2026-10-03..14. 128 GB HBM2e, 3200 GB/s, gfx90a. ASKING price, not sold. PERISHABLE-FIGURE STAMP: OBSERVED 2026-10-14. RE-VERIFY BY: 2027-01-14.
lead_time_basis: lead_time_weeks is null because this is a secondary market priced per listing.
export_control_regime: EAR (check ECCN 3A090 thresholds for MI250X at purchase) + EAR 744.23 / 744.6 party screening
export_control_note: MI250X is a high-end CDNA2 part; verify export classification at purchase. General EAR plus party screening applies.
notes: 128 GB / 3.2 TB/s is a lot of card, but OAM means you NEED the chassis - a Delta/GBT/HPE Cray front-end, 560 W liquid-class cooling. Only sensible if you already own an OAM host; you cannot put it in a workstation. 4x MI250 reported working via PCIe passthrough VM (llama.cpp discussion #2824). gfx90a fully supported on the ROCm 10 matrix.
